title: EverQuote Reports Q3 2026 Revenue of $218.1 Million
summary: EverQuote reported Q3 2026 revenue of $218.1 million, up 25% from a year earlier, and GAAP net income of $18.2 million, compared to $18.9 million.
body_markdown:
The company said GAAP net income of $18.2 million, compared to $18.9 million, reflects higher income taxes and the impact of a one-time item in the quarter. Adjusted EBITDA, a non-GAAP measure, grew 41% to $35.5 million, compared to $25.1 million, and operating cash flow was $40.5 million, compared to $19.8 million. EverQuote ended the quarter with $229.1 million in cash and cash equivalents and no outstanding debt.


For the fourth quarter of 2026, the company gave an outlook of revenue of $213.0 million to $223.0 million, Variable Marketing Dollars of $57.0 million to $60.0 million and Adjusted EBITDA of $29.0 million to $32.0 million.


## Why It Matters for EVER


According to the release, the third-quarter results exceeded the company's Q3 guidance and set records on all of its key metrics. “We are generating record results across our key financial metrics as we successfully grow and deepen our relationships with our carrier and agent customers,” Chief Executive Officer Jayme Mendal said, adding that carriers “continue to maintain strong underwriting profitability and an appetite for growth.”
